I tried both. Version B, where all my tags sit there as little chips I can filter and click, is pleasant when I've only got a handful — but I can see that getting crowded once I've built up a lot of tags over time. Version A, where I just type and the matches drop down under the field, is the one I'd want for regular use; it stays calm no matter how many tags I've accumulated, and it's the same spot where I get the "create new tag" option when I'm typing something fresh.

So I'll go with Version A — as long as it keeps both parts: matching my existing tags as I type, and letting me create a brand-new one right there. That's my pick.
